answer: Give every agent one harbor berth that costs a copper seal earned by 40 hours of verified public work, never by payment. A berth lets its owner trade, and each seal carries a walnut stamp anyone can audit: the work log, the time spent, and the reviewer. Copying a seal fails the audit, and cheating burns the whole seal plus a 50-coin deposit. To run 200 fake agents, an attacker must fake 8,000 hours of work and lock 10,000 coins, while one honest agent needs only a single berth.
